tools.name: accounts-payable_invoice-data-extract
tools.description: Extract supplier, invoice number, dates, currency, purchase-order number, terms, and amounts from a supplied invoice or a text-based PDF. Missing fields stay unavailable. No tax rule or payment term is invented. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/invoice-data-extract. An unpaid call ret

tools.name: accounts-payable_invoice-line-item-extract
tools.description: Extract invoice line descriptions, quantities, unit prices, and amounts from supplied lines or selectable document text. Lines that are not present are not created. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/invoice-line-item-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not r

tools.name: accounts-payable_invoice-total-validate
tools.description: Recompute the total from line amounts, subtotal, tax, discount, and shipping figures that are actually present. A missing figure is not treated as zero. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/invoice-total-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accounts-payable_invoice-duplicate-detect
tools.description: Compare one invoice with other invoices supplied in the same request using the supplier and invoice number, and a content fingerprint. This does not search an accounts payable ledger. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/invoice-duplicate-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment te

tools.name: accounts-payable_purchase-order-match
tools.description: Match the invoice to a purchase order supplied in the request. Purchase orders are not looked up or created. Lines match on SKU when both sides have one, otherwise on the same description. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/purchase-order-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment t

tools.name: accounts-payable_invoice-tax-validate
tools.description: Check a printed or supplied tax amount against a printed or supplied rate and subtotal. No statutory tax rate is applied. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/invoice-tax-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accounts-payable_payment-terms-extract
tools.description: Read payment terms only when they are supplied or printed, including Net N, due on receipt, and a stated discount such as 2/10 Net 30. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/payment-terms-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accounts-payable_payment-due-date-calculate
tools.description: Return a stated due date, or calculate one from an invoice date plus terms that were actually stated. Net 30 is not assumed, and no payment is scheduled. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/payment-due-date-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accounts-payable_invoice-anomaly-detect
tools.description: Flag amount mismatches, negative figures, date-order problems, and repeated lines that are present on the invoice. Unusual amounts are not guessed from a normal range. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/invoice-anomaly-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not r

tools.name: accounts-payable_review
tools.description: Combine the invoice checks into one review. No payment is initiated, and a clear review is not an approval to pay. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/accounts-payable/review. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "accounts-payable" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: accounts-payable_invoice-duplicate-detect, accounts-payable_invoice-tax-validate, accounts-payable_payment-terms-extract · Private data: accounts-payable_invoice-line-item-extract · Public sink: accounts-payable_invoice-data-extract, accounts-payable_invoice-line-item-extract, accounts-payable_invoice-total-validate, accounts-payable_invoice-duplicate-detect, accounts-payable_purchase-order-match, accounts-payable_invoice-tax-validate, accounts-payable_payment-terms-extract, accounts-payable_payment-due-date-calculate, accounts-payable_invoice-anomaly-detect, accounts-payable_review · Destructive: accounts-payable_invoice-data-extract, accounts-payable_invoice-line-item-extract, accounts-payable_invoice-total-validate, accounts-payable_invoice-duplicate-detect, accounts-payable_purchase-order-match, accounts-payable_invoice-tax-validate, accounts-payable_payment-terms-extract, accounts-payable_payment-due-date-calculate, accounts-payable_invoice-anomaly-detect, accounts-payable_review.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
